tools.name: legal_breakdown
tools.description: Describe a legal situation; get the verified provisions that apply with official-source links. jurisdiction: ru|in|us|uk|ca|hk. Returns a refusal when the corpus has no norm.

tools.name: oracle_lookup
tools.description: Legal Oracle: which verified provisions relate to a query. Optional jurisdiction filter. An empty list means the corpus has no norm for this query.

tools.name: verify_citation
tools.description: Legal Oracle: does this citation exist in the verified corpus? Use before relying on any code/article pair. found=false means do not rely on it.
